testCases.input: Under the Insurance Contract Act, if a subsequent premium is not paid on time, what payment deadline can the insurer set for the policyholder?
testCases.actualOutput:
Under the Insurance Contract Act (VVG), if a subsequent premium is not paid on time, the insurer can set a payment deadline for the policyholder of no less than two weeks. This deadline must be communicated in writing and includes details about the individual amounts in arrears, any interest and costs, as well as the legal consequences associated with the expiry of the time limit.

References:
- VVG, Section 38, page 15.
